title: Sequence and IteratorProtocol
summary: Create a reusable countdown sequence whose iterator returns nil when exhausted.
triggers: produce values lazily with a custom iterator and a clear exhaustion condition
prompts: Expose a positive countdown that can be consumed with a for loop or Array initializer.
invariant: Each iterator yields descending positive integers, then keeps returning nil.
mantra: Make an iterator; yield one value; advance its state.
pitfalls: Return nil rather than a sentinel integer when iteration ends.
Each call to makeIterator starts a fresh traversal in this sequence.
